sa.v1.101.user_audio.u1.script: Which hand on your tide-clock tracks the solar tides?

sa.v1.109.user_audio.u2.script: Why is the sealed one better?

sa.v1.110.user_audio.u1.script: I heard the Orion projector is showing the Mars documentary. What resolution does it support?

sa.v1.114.user_audio.u3.script: And where are the older maritime maps kept?

sa.v1.117.user_audio.u2.script: Great. So just to confirm, my certificate overrides the noon restriction entirely?

sa.v1.118.user_audio.u2.script: Actually, I also must arrive before midnight. Does that change your recommendation?

sa.v1.119.user_audio.u3.script: For my log, does the cabin-seven exclusion still apply to that departure?

sa.v1.120.user_audio.u2.script: Now remove the silver mask. What remains?

sa.v1.120.user_audio.u3.script: I did not add anything else. Confirm what is left.

sa.v1.121.user_audio.u1.script: Excuse me, how long is the full loop up here, because I need to know if—

sa.v1.121.user_audio.u2.script: Hey! Is this platform rated for twenty people at once?

sa.v1.121.user_audio.u3.script: Sorry about that, please go on.

sa.v1.122.user_audio.u2.script: After that noise clears, where do we store the sediment cores?

sa.v1.122.user_audio.u3.script: Do I need a separate keycard for the cold room?

sa.v1.125.user_audio.u2.script: So where do I take my old window panes then?

sa.v1.126.user_audio.u2.script: I'm the night-shift inventory clerk, so I need precise records. Can you confirm what the log directly observed about the red thermos?

sa.v1.126.user_audio.u3.script: Given my clerk duties, which lost items are confirmed by direct observation versus inferred missing from the shelves?

sa.v1.127.user_audio.u1.script: I only want to approve watercolor-style murals for the downtown corridor permits.

sa.v1.127.user_audio.u2.script: Wait, I also need every site we approve to be fully wheelchair accessible with ramps.

sa.v1.127.user_audio.u3.script: So which of your three downtown blocks actually meet both the watercolor rule and the ramp requirement now?

sa.v1.127.user_audio.u4.script: Got it. Please keep that combined filter active for the rest of our session.

sa.v1.128.user_audio.u2.script: Let's go with the holiday-box campaign instead. Actually, move it to Friday evenings so it doesn't overlap.

sa.v1.128.user_audio.u3.script: Wait, remind me—which of those two proposals did I just reject?

sa.v1.129.user_audio.u1.script: I signed up for the deep-sky session but I was wondering if maybe...

sa.v1.129.user_audio.u2.script: ...if maybe we could switch to the planetary viewing instead?

sa.v1.129.user_audio.u3.script: Great. What time does it start?

sa.v1.130.user_audio.u1.script: I wanted to ask how indigo—actually wait, which mordant is logged for the blue swatch?

sa.v1.130.user_audio.u2.script: And which swatch uses iron in your log?

sa.v1.130.user_audio.u3.script: Hold on, I am still checking this label...

sa.v1.130.user_audio.u4.script: Found it. Which container takes the used blue-swatch bath?

sa.v1.133.user_audio.u2.script: What is the standard salinity for our display tanks?

sa.v1.133.user_audio.u3.script: How often do we cycle the green macroalgae?

sa.v1.133.user_audio.u4.script: I need to update the visitor log format. What fields are required?

sa.v1.133.user_audio.u5.script: Going back to my first question, which organism was it again?

sa.v1.133.user_audio.u6.script: And what is the current registry status of those organisms?

sa.v1.134.user_audio.u3.script: Do I need gloves while rolling the ink on a slab?

sa.v1.134.user_audio.u4.script: Do beginners get to try woodblock as well as linocut?

sa.v1.134.user_audio.u5.script: With my soy-based choice, what rules should I remember before carving?

sa.v1.135.user_audio.u1.script: I think I will take the north ridge trail up to the viewing platform tonight.

sa.v1.135.user_audio.u2.script: Can you tell me more about borrowing that field telescope? What comes with it? I have never used one before.

sa.v1.135.user_audio.u3.script: Oh wow, so anyone can check it out? Do I need my own tripod? Also, what constellations are easiest for beginners?

sa.v1.135.user_audio.u4.script: That is really helpful. I did not know Orion was so easy to spot. How long does the lending paperwork usually take?

sa.v1.135.user_audio.u5.script: Right, just a quick form. Anyway, remind me which trail I decided to take earlier so I do not get lost in the dark.

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u1.script: I need a beginner wall slot for the ten o'clock session.

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u2.script: Add two harness rentals to that booking please.

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u3.script: We actually have five people now, not three.

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u4.script: Can we push our slot to the twelve o'clock one instead?

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u5.script: What does my final booking look like?

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u6.script: And the two-hour duration stays the same, right?

sa.v1.136.user_audio.u7.script: Great, no extra fees for beginners I assume?

sa.v1.137.user_audio.u2.script: Sorry, those people behind me are just chatting. My question is how long we warm up.

sa.v1.137.user_audio.u3.script: Wait, ignore them arguing over there. Are tenors on the right riser?

sa.v1.137.user_audio.u4.script: They are still debating. Anyway, how many music copies did you print?

sa.v1.137.user_audio.u5.script: Okay last thing before we start, can someone bring their phone out during practice?

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u2.script: I'm researching the early forties. Was there a notable hurricane recorded around then?

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u3.script: Actually, let me check my notes first. Hold on.

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u4.script: Okay, found them. I'm specifically interested in the biggest storm you have on record overall.

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u5.script: Wait, I need to be more precise. I meant the one that set the lowest pressure reading ever at this station.

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u6.script: Yes, that's the one. How does its severity compare to everything else you've cataloged?

sa.v1.138.user_audio.u7.script: Thank you, Priya. That covers everything I needed.

sa.v1.141.speech_audio.s1.script: Welcome to the deep ocean exhibit.

sa.v1.149.speech_audio.s1.script: Observe how the relic shifts under light.

sa.v1.150.speech_audio.s1.script: Always secure your guard before starting the saw blade.

sa.v1.151.speech_audio.s1.script: Watch closely here, then observe the distant light.

sa.v1.152.speech_audio.s1.script: Please observe the texture of this ancient artifact carefully.

sa.v1.153.speech_audio.s1.script: Hold the brace steady while I turn.

sa.v1.154.speech_audio.s1.script: Step up, hold the balance now.

sa.v1.157.speech_audio.s1.script: Barnacles filter tiny plankton from each passing wave constantly.

sa.v1.158.speech_audio.s1.script: The arctic terns begin their southern journey today.

sa.v1.159.speech_audio.s1.script: The constellation rotates fifteen degrees per hour.

sa.v1.160.speech_audio.s1.script: Read the ancient steps silently now.

sa.v1.161.speech_audio.s1.script: Fold the silk gently along the crease.

sa.v1.162.speech_audio.s1.script: Hold the gate shut like this.

sa.v1.165.speech_audio.s1.script: The storm gathered beyond the cliffs, silent and waiting.

sa.v1.168.speech_audio.s1.script: Readers, observe this panel closely now.

sa.v1.169.speech_audio.s1.script: Extend your striking arm slowly now.

sa.v1.170.speech_audio.s1.script: Hold the pointer exactly halfway up now.

sa.v1.173.speech_audio.s1.script: Brass enters first, strings follow my downbeat.

sa.v1.175.speech_audio.s1.script: These heirloom tomatoes need gentle morning light only.
